theater: 的黎波里灣與巴巴利海岸

battle.name: 第一次巴巴利戰爭
battle.theater: 的黎波里灣與巴巴利海岸
battle.brief: 1801年5月美國對的黎波里宣戰，遠征巴巴利海岸。1797年下水、額定四十四門砲的巡洋艦「憲法號」在普雷布爾分艦隊中執行封鎖、炮擊與夜襲任務，1812年再以「老鐵匠」之名迎戰英艦，寫下美國海軍最著名的戰役傳奇。

kit.name: 憲法號巡航艦
kit.history: 隸屬美國海軍，屬早期大型帆船巡航艦兵力，負責遠洋航行、商船護航與戰區封鎖，並可搭載艦載火炮執行海上作戰。

countries: 交戰一方是美利堅合眾國。1801年傑佛遜政府以海軍實力取代向巴巴利諸國繳納年貢的做法，5月14日先對的黎波里宣戰，7月再對阿爾及爾、突尼斯與摩洛哥宣戰；戰事由新組成的地中海分艦隊承擔，1801年由理查德·德爾率隊，1803年5月由愛德華·普雷布爾接掌分艦隊，1804年底改由理查德·索默斯接任，直到1805年6月和約簽訂。美國方面以六艘新建巡洋艦為骨幹，輔以雙桅縱帆船、單桅炮艇與海軍陸戰隊的登陸部隊，並在東岸港口設維修廠與補給船，維持跨越四千海里的遠距離存在。巴巴利一方是三個各自獨立的政權：的黎波里由卡拉馬利帕夏執政，1801年率先宣戰，倚仗海灣內成群的輕型快船（xebec）與沿岸石造砲台，直到1815年才被攻滅；阿爾及爾由穆斯塔法·艾哈邁德統治，以私掠商船與扣押船員為主要收入；突尼斯由哈穆達·伊本·阿里統治，海軍規模雖小卻備有大小戰船多艘；摩洛哥在蘇丹穆萊·拉希姆治下未積極參戰，仍被美國列入宣戰對象。三國名義上互不隸屬，卻共享同一套「不納貢即以武力奪取」的做派，也共享同一批被強迫服役的水手與奴隸來源，這正是美國把三者視為同一場戰爭的理由。
countriesEn: One belligerent was the United States of America. The Jefferson administration resolved to answer the Barbary states with naval power rather than annual tribute, declaring war on Tripoli on 14 May 1801 and following on in July against Algiers, Tunis and Morocco. The war was fought by a newly constituted Mediterranean squadron: Richard Dale led it in 1801, Edward Preble took over the squadron in May 1803, and Richard Somers succeeded him towards the end of 1804, holding the command until the peace treaty was signed in June 1805. The American side was built around six new frigates, supported by two-masted brigs and schooners, single-masted gunboats and the landing detachments of the Marine Corps, with repair yards and supply ships on the eastern seaboard sustaining a presence four thousand nautical miles from home. On the Barbary side were three mutually independent states. Tripoli, ruled by the pasha Yusuf Karamanli, declared war first in 1801 and relied on the swarms of light xebecs in the bay and on stone batteries along the shore; it would not fall until 1815. Algiers, under Mustafa Ahmed, drew its principal revenue from privateering and the seizure of seamen. Tunis, under Hammuda ibn Ali, fielded a small navy but with a number of war galleys and larger vessels. Morocco, under the sultan Slimane, took no active part and yet was nonetheless named in the American declarations of war. The three were not subordinate to one another, but they shared the same practice of taking what was not paid for by force, and the same pool of forced labour and enslaved seamen. That common character was the reason the Americans treated them as a single war.
people: 關鍵人物分屬兩邊。美國方面，總統托馬斯·傑佛遜是整場戰爭的決策者：他在1800年11月就任後即拒絕再向巴巴利諸國繳納年貢，主張以海軍實力保護商船，並於1801年4月致函四國要求停止掠奪，隨後批准對的黎波里的宣戰與地中海分艦隊的派遣；第二任總統約翰·亞當斯留下的六艘巡洋艦是這場戰爭全部的海上骨幹，「憲法號」正是他那套造艦計劃的產物。作戰層面上，理查德·德爾中校率領1802年第一次遠征，因判斷失當在的黎波里外海折損Hornet與Wasp兩艘船；愛德華·普雷布爾上校1803年接任分艦隊司令，在兩年間策劃了1803年5月21日與8月10日兩次攻擊的黎波里，以及1804年6月3日強攻海港；威廉·班布里奇中校在1803年10月31日率「費城號」進港時被俘，翌年6月率海軍陸戰隊與水兵登陸反攻並奪回該船；1804年6月28日夜襲中威廉·卡辛中尉所率小艇傾覆，他與十餘人一同溺斃；同年8月3日斯蒂芬·迪凱特中尉帶人縱火焚燒被俘的「費城號」；11月4日，理查德·索默斯少校駕駛裝載炸藥的火船「Intrepid」闖入港口，被岸砲擊中爆炸，全船無人生還；「國會號」艦長雅各布·瓊斯中校在1804年的交火中陣亡。巴巴利方面，的黎波里的卡拉馬利帕夏是整場戰爭的對手與決策核心，阿爾及爾的穆斯塔法·艾哈邁德與突尼斯的哈穆達·伊本·阿里亦各自主導私掠與扣人的體制。
peopleEn: The decisive figures fall on two sides. On the American side, President Thomas Jefferson was the author of the whole war: taking office in November 1800 he refused to pay further annual tribute to the Barbary states, argued that naval power should protect American shipping, and in April 1801 sent letters to the four states demanding an end to depredation, then approved the declaration of war on Tripoli and the dispatch of the Mediterranean squadron. The six frigates ordered by the second president, John Adams, were the entire seagoing strength available for this war, and the Constitution was the product of that building programme. At the operational level, Commander Richard Dale led the first expedition of 1802 and lost the Hornet and the Wasp off Tripoli through faulty judgement. Commander Edward Preble assumed command of the squadron in 1803 and in two years planned the attacks on Tripoli of 21 May and 10 August 1803 and the assault on the harbour of 3 June 1804. Commander William Bainbridge was captured on 31 October 1803 when he took the Philadelphia into the harbour, and in June of the following year he led Marines and sailors ashore in a counterstroke that retook the ship. On the night of 28 June 1804 the boat of Lieutenant William Cushing capsized and he drowned with more than a dozen men; on 3 August 1804 Lieutenant Stephen Decatur set fire to the captured Philadelphia with his own hands. On 4 November of the same year Lieutenant Richard Somers took the powder-laden fire ship Intrepid into the harbour, where shore guns blew her up and no one came out alive. Commander Jacob Jones of the Congress was killed in the fighting of 1804. On the Barbary side, Yusuf Karamanli of Tripoli was the opposing decision-maker for the entire war, while Mustafa Ahmed of Algiers and Hammuda ibn Ali of Tunis each ran the system of privateering and the taking of captives.
kits: 卡面兵器是「憲法號」巡洋艦（USS Constitution），1797年在波士頓下水，是美國海軍最早一批巡洋艦中保存至今的一艘，設計者是海軍工程師約書亞·漢弗萊斯，造船由艾德蒙·哈特與艾薩克·皮斯承造。規格方面，它為三桅木殼帆船，槍砲甲板長一百七十五英尺、全長約二百零四英尺，舷寬四十三英尺六英寸，排水量約二千二百噸，額定四十四門砲，以十二磅與二十四磅的火砲為主，另配三十二磅與六十八磅重砲；乘員約四百五十人，滿帆最大航速可超過十三節，橡木厚殼外包鐵皮，正因如此它在一場英式齊射之後仍舊浮在水面，還得了「老鐵匠」的綽號。戰時它是分艦隊中最能承受火力、也最能與岸砲對射的單位，兼負封鎖警戒、主力交戰與遠海巡邏三種任務。與它同期的是美國海軍另外五艘巡洋艦：國會號、切薩皮克號、費城號、合眾國號與總統號；小型艦艇則有Hornet、Argus、Nautilus等雙桅快船與Spitfire炮艇。巴巴利方面的裝備以數十艘輕型快船（xebec）為主，艇身狹長、首尾尖削，常裝八至十六門小砲，能在夜裡貼近美艦放火；岸上則有西迪巴拉尼與的黎波里港內的石造砲台，並以單峰駱駝馱載火藥、糧食與淡水供應海岸炮兵，另有大批被強迫在艦上服役的水手。登陸的美軍靠艦上小艇與划艇分隊送上岸，配備斧、矛、火藥與撬棍，奪下砲台之後以火藥炸毀砲身、毀掉磁針，並把停泊的船隻就地燒毀。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the frigate USS Constitution, launched at Boston in 1797, the survivor of the first generation of American frigates, designed by the naval engineer Joshua Humphreys and built by Edmund Hartt and Isaac Peace. In specification she was a three-masted wooden ship: her gun deck measured 175 feet and her length overall about 204 feet, with a beam of 43 feet 6 inches and a displacement of roughly 2,200 tons. She was rated 44 guns, principally 12- and 24-pounder pieces, with 32- and 68-pounders besides, carried a complement of about 450 men, and exceeded 13 knots under full sail. Her thick oak hull was sheathed in iron, which is why she remained afloat after an English broadside and how she came by the nickname Old Ironsides. In the service she was the unit of the squadron best able to absorb punishment and best placed to trade fire with shore batteries, and she carried three tasks at once: blockade watch, main fleet engagement and long-range patrol. Alongside her were the other five American frigates, the Congress, Chesapeake, Philadelphia, United States and President, together with small craft such as the brigs Hornet, Argus and Nautilus and the gunboat Spitfire. The Barbary side relied on several dozen light xebecs, long and narrow in the hull with fine ends, commonly carrying eight to sixteen small guns, which could creep up on American ships at night and set them alight; on shore stood the stone batteries of Sidi Barrani and of the Tripoli harbour, with single-humped camels carrying powder, grain and water to the coastal artillery, and a large number of men forced to serve at sea. The American landing parties went ashore in the ships' boats and in pulled launches, equipped with axes, pikes, powder and bars; once a battery was taken they blew up the guns, spoiled the magnetic compasses and burned the vessels lying in the roads.
tactics: 雙方的作戰方式差距很大，戰爭的勝負正由此決定。美國採取「海上封鎖加炮兵攻擊」的組合：以巡洋艦封鎖的黎波里港口，斷其糧食、火藥與木材的輸入；再以數艘主力艦在白晝進港，採縱隊隊形依次穿過海峽兩側砲台的射界，利用較快的航速與靈活的轉向，在數百碼距離上向砲台傾側砲火，迫使其炮位集中火力而顧此失彼；夜間則放下小艇分隊靠近岸砲與船塢，以火藥炸毀砲身、鑿穿城牆，並把奪得的船隻拖走。1804年6月3日的大舉攻擊更結合水陸兩面：普雷布爾的艦隊在海上纏鬥，海軍陸戰隊與水兵乘艇由兩側突入碼頭，奪取砲台後就地破壞，再以火藥燒掉停泊中的船隻。巴巴利方面的戰術則充分利用其小艇的數量優勢：夜間以成群的快船逼近美軍泊地，或縱火筏順流漂下，或以火箭與火桶攻擊船舷，企圖在美軍集中火力的間隙中縱火；岸上砲台多設在海峽口的突出處，射界廣闊，主砲射程可覆蓋整條進港航道；突尼斯與阿爾及爾更以掠來的商船為誘餌，誘使美艦離開封鎖位置，再由快船群攻擊落單的船隻。美軍的補給線長達四千海里，靠定期的糧食船與酒船輸送，艦上日常靠自帶淡水、鹹肉與硬餅維持，因此每次遠征的時間上限並非完全由敵人決定，而是由艦員的糧食與飲水存量決定，這也是普雷布爾堅持在有限窗口內速戰速決、而不是長期屯泊的原因。
tacticsEn: The two sides fought in ways that were very different, and the outcome was decided by that difference. The Americans combined a naval blockade with an artillery assault: frigates closed the port of Tripoli to cut off its grain, powder and timber, and then a few capital ships entered by day in line ahead, passing in turn through the fields of fire of the batteries on either side of the strait, using their greater speed and easier handling to bring the guns to bear at a few hundred yards and force the batteries to concentrate on one of two dangers. At night boats were lowered to creep up on the shore guns and the shipyard, blow up the gun barrels, cut the walls and tow off captured vessels. The great assault of 3 June 1804 combined sea and land: Preble's squadron fought in the bay while Marines and sailors entered the mole in boats from both sides, seized the batteries, wrecked them on the spot and fired the vessels lying in the roads. The Barbaries used the numerical advantage of their small craft: at night swarms of xebecs closed on the American anchorage, or floated fire rafts down with the current, or threw rockets and fire pots against the ships' sides, hoping to ignite the fleet in the gaps between concentrated American salvos. The shore batteries were usually sited on the projecting points of the strait, with wide fields of fire and main guns covering the entire approach channel. Tunis and Algiers used captured merchantmen as bait to draw American ships off the blockade, then sent the xebecs against the isolated victims. The American supply line ran four thousand nautical miles and was kept alive by periodic storeships and wine ships, while at sea the ships lived on their own water, salt meat and hard biscuit. The limit on the duration of any expedition was therefore not set entirely by the enemy but by how much food and water the crews had left, and that is why Preble insisted on hitting hard and fast within a narrow window rather than lying at anchor for months.
data: 可核對的數字集中在火力與人數上。「憲法號」1797年下水，額定四十四門砲，排水量約二千二百噸，編制人員約四百五十人，航速可逾十三節，橡木殼外包鐵皮，可承擔歐洲式重砲的連續齊射。1803年5月21日普雷布爾率九艘各型軍艦攻擊的黎波里，美方記錄為陣亡十五人、受傷五十九人，巴巴利方面的損失常記為陣亡約三十人、受傷約一百二十四人；此役美軍奪獲的黎波里船隻數艘。1803年8月10日的第二次炮擊中，雙方再互換一批傷亡。1804年6月3日強攻海港，美方陣亡四人、受傷三十人，奪獲巴巴利砲艇兩艘並在碼頭破壞其火藥庫；同年6月28日夜襲失利，威廉·卡辛中尉以下十餘人溺斃，兩艘小艇被毀；8月3日迪凱特焚燒被俘的「費城號」得手；11月4日索默斯率裝載炸藥的「Intrepid」衝入港口，觸發爆炸，全船無人生還。被俘的「費城號」是三十六門砲、約三千三百噸的巡洋艦，1803年10月31日連同艦上約六百人一同落入的黎波里之手，1804年12月焚毀於港內，其人員遺骸於1805年運回美國安葬。時間方面，自1801年5月宣戰到1805年6月4日在華盛頓簽訂和約，前後約四年；美方在此役投入的地中海分艦隊常年維持在九至十艘船的規模，美國海軍的年度撥款亦由1800年代初的一百多萬美元增加到1805年的三百多萬美元。整場戰爭雙方死傷合計的精確數字已不可考，巴巴利方面的記錄散佚各方估計相差甚遠，學界一般僅能確認美軍的陣亡與被俘為數百人規模。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are mainly those of weapons and men. The Constitution was launched in 1797, rated 44 guns, of about 2,200 tons displacement, with a complement near 450 and a speed above 13 knots; her iron-sheathed oak hull could stand the weight of a European broadside fired in succession. On 21 May 1803 Preble attacked Tripoli with nine vessels of assorted types: the American record gives 15 killed and 59 wounded, and Barbary losses are usually given as about 30 killed and about 124 wounded; the Americans took a number of Tripolitan vessels. In the second bombardment of 10 August 1803 the two sides exchanged another set of casualties. In the assault on the harbour of 3 June 1804 the Americans lost four killed and thirty wounded, took two Barbary gunboats and destroyed the powder store on the mole. In the night attack of 28 June 1804 Cushing and more than a dozen men drowned and two boats were lost; on 3 August Decatur succeeded in burning the captured Philadelphia; on 4 November Somers took the Intrepid in among the batteries and was destroyed with all hands. The captured Philadelphia was a 36-gun frigate of about 3,300 tons, taken on 31 October 1803 together with some six hundred of her company, and she burned in the harbour in December 1804; her dead were returned to the United States and buried in 1805. In time, from the declaration of war in May 1801 to the treaty signed at Washington on 4 June 1805 the war ran about four years. The American Mediterranean squadron was kept at a strength of nine to ten vessels year round, and the Navy's annual appropriation rose from a little over a million dollars in the early 1800s to something over three million by 1805. The exact total of casualties on both sides can no longer be established, the Barbary records are scattered and estimates differ widely, and the general consensus holds only that American dead and captured numbered in the hundreds.
cause: 打起來有兩層原因交疊。巴巴利諸國的勒索制度是直接原因：的黎波里、阿爾及爾與突尼斯長期要求外國商船繳納年貢，攔截商船、扣押船員、將其賣為奴隸，若不從命就動用武力；美國商船自1783年獨立後在地中海的航線日漸繁忙，被劫與被扣的事件累積增加，而當時美國在巴巴利海岸並無任何駐泊力量。傑佛遜政府的應對把衝突推向前台：他上任後拒絕承認年貢的義務，1801年初致函四國要求停止掠奪並承諾保護美國商船，的黎波里的卡拉馬利帕夏視之為對其財政的宣戰，於5月先發制人宣告開戰，7月美國再對其餘三國宣戰。此外還有雙方各自的算計：巴巴利方面若對美讓步，其他歐洲國家也會跟著拒付，這套「不繳就被奪」的慣例一旦被打破，其海軍與私掠收入即失去依據，因此寧可承擔全面戰爭的風險也要維持威懾；美國方面則在國內主戰與主和之間選擇了主戰，理由是海軍的存在若不能阻止商船被奪，所謂海權與國格便無從談起，況且一批新一代巡洋艦恰好在此時完成，既能作戰又不需要另撥大筆軍費，開戰的成本看似可控。1802年5月第一次遠征因缺乏經驗、敵情判斷錯誤而折損兩艘船，成為美國改採封鎖加反覆炮擊、並尋求夜襲與奪船等非常手段的直接刺激。
causeEn: Two sets of cause overlap. The predatory system of the Barbary states was the immediate one: Tripoli, Algiers and Tunis had long required foreign shipping to pay annual tribute, and they intercepted merchantmen, seized their crews and sold them into slavery, using force whenever payment was refused. American trade in the Mediterranean had grown busier since the independence of 1783, arrests and seizures accumulated, and at that time the United States had no force of any kind stationed on the Barbary coast. The response of the Jefferson administration pushed the conflict into the open: refusing to recognise the obligation of tribute, it wrote to the four states early in 1801 demanding an end to depredation and promising to protect American shipping, and the pasha of Tripoli, Yusuf Karamanli, read this as a war on his treasury, declared war first in May, and the United States followed against the remaining three in July. There were also calculations on both sides. If the Barbaries gave way to the Americans, the European states would follow suit in refusing payment, and once the practice of taking what was not paid for by force collapsed their navies and their privateering income would lose their basis; they preferred to bear the risk of a general war rather than give up the threat. The Americans chose war over negotiation at home on the ground that a navy which could not stop merchantmen being taken could make no claim to sea power or national honour, and because a new generation of frigates had just been completed, capable of fighting and requiring no vast new appropriation, so that the cost of going to war looked controllable. The loss of two ships in the first expedition of May 1802, through inexperience and misreading the enemy, was the direct stimulus for the Americans to adopt blockade combined with repeated bombardment, and to look for irregular measures such as night attacks and cutting out.
impact: 這場戰爭在美國史上第一次把海軍用成解決外交與經濟問題的工具，而不是被動的守成力量。最直接的結果是年貢制度的終結：自1805年條約生效起，美國商船不再向巴巴利諸國繳納任何年貢，雖然的黎波里拖到同年7月才簽約，但歐洲其他國家仍需繼續繳付，這種差別成為美國在十九世紀地中海地位的基礎。美國商船得以在沒有護航費用負擔的情況下進入地中海，1783年獨立以來被巴巴利私掠船擄走的貨物與船員不再無聲無息地消失，商業風險與保險費率的結構因此改變。制度層面，海軍陸戰隊在1804年的兩次登陸作戰中獲得實戰經驗，1805年6月更以水陸配合攻入阿克卡與薩法德，雖然被迫撤回，卻讓這支部隊自此成為美國在地中海維持存在、執行護航與撤退的常備力量；海軍本身也在戰後獲得新造巡洋艦的補充，編制與訓練為1812年戰爭前的擴張打下基礎，而1812年8月19日「憲法號」擊敗英艦「鐵衛者號」、同年再與「豹號」交手的表現，反過來又證明四年前這批船確實經得起實戰。對巴巴利三國而言，這場戰爭是掠奪事業的斷點：突尼斯的海軍幾乎被夜襲全毀，阿爾及爾退出戰局，的黎波里雖未屈服，其沿岸砲台與船塢卻被反覆破壞，私掠能力大減。國際層面上，此役之後美國在巴巴利海岸長期維持駐泊的打算與能力，也讓歐洲列強重新評估英國在美洲的擴張，成為英美在1812年走向對抗的遠景之一。
impactEn: For the first time in American history this war used the navy as an instrument for solving diplomatic and economic problems rather than as a passive means of defence. The most immediate result was the end of the tribute system: from the entry into force of the 1805 treaty American shipping paid no annual tribute to any Barbary state, and though Tripoli held out until July of the same year, the European states went on paying; that difference became the foundation of the American position in the Mediterranean during the nineteenth century. American ships could enter the Mediterranean without carrying the cost of convoy duty, and cargoes and crews seized by Barbary privateers since 1783 no longer disappeared without trace, so the structure of commercial risk and insurance rates changed. Institutionally, the Marine Corps gained its first field experience in the landings of 1804, and in June 1805 a combined sea and land operation carried it into Acre and Safed; though it was compelled to withdraw, the corps emerged from that as the standing force by which the United States maintained a presence in the Mediterranean, ran convoys and covered withdrawals. The navy itself was reinforced with newly built frigates after the war, and its organisation and training laid the groundwork for the expansion that preceded the War of 1812; that the Constitution beat Guerriere on 19 August 1812 and fought the Leopard in the same year showed in turn that the ships of four years earlier had indeed survived real fighting. For the three Barbary states the war was a break in the business of plunder: the Tunisian navy was almost entirely destroyed by a night attack, Algiers dropped out of the war, and Tripoli, though undefeated, had its shore batteries and shipyards repeatedly wrecked and its capacity for privateering greatly reduced. At the international level, the American intention and ability to keep a permanent force on the Barbary coast after this war led the European powers to reassess British expansion in the Americas, forming part of the longer background to Anglo-American conflict in 1812.
result: 1805年春，美國海軍在的黎波里外海的最後一輪炮擊與封鎖，迫使的黎波里同意談判。4月底至5月初，突尼斯率先接受美方提出的條件；6月4日，美國代表與突尼斯、阿爾及爾及的黎波里三方的領事在華盛頓簽訂和約，核心條款是：美國不再繳納年貢，巴巴利諸國歸還被扣的美國人與財產，雙方恢復正常通商，一個半世紀以來困擾美國地中海貿易的勒索制度就此終結。戰爭最後階段的具體成果還包括：1805年6月斯蒂芬·迪凱特率分艦隊夜襲突尼斯港，縱火焚毀其泊地內的戰船並奪取一艘什巴克快船；被俘「費城號」的人員遺骸運回美國安葬；以及的黎波里同意釋放仍扣押的美國人質。戰後的意義並非全然正面：巴巴利海岸並未因此變得安定，突尼斯與阿爾及爾雖然停戰，掠奪與扣人以另一種形式延續，美國最終要等到1815年第二次巴巴利戰爭攻陷的黎波里，才算真正解決問題；美國自己也付出高昂代價，遠征的艦隊往返四千海里，補給與駐防成本沉重，國內對遠洋冒險的爭論一直延續到十九世紀的奴隸貿易與英美衝突之中。而「憲法號」這條老船在戰後沉入無聲的船塢，成為海軍傳統的守護象徵，直到1812年再度出海，把巴巴利戰爭期間累積的經驗與名聲一起帶進那場更大的戰爭。
resultEn: In the spring of 1805 a final round of bombardment and blockade off Tripoli forced the pasha to consent to negotiate. From late April into early May Tunis accepted the American terms first; on 4 June representatives of the United States signed the treaty at Washington with the consuls of Tunis, Algiers and Tripoli, its core terms being that the United States would pay no tribute, that the Barbary states would restore the Americans and property they held, and that normal trade would resume. The tribute system that had troubled American Mediterranean trade for a century and a half came to an end. The specific results of the closing phase include the night attack on Tunis in June 1805, when Decatur's squadron fired the warships lying in the roads and took a xebec; the return to the United States of the dead of the captured Philadelphia for burial; and the agreement of Tripoli to release the Americans it still held. The significance was not entirely positive. The Barbary coast did not become settled, and although Tunis and Algiers had made peace, depredation and the taking of captives continued in another form; the Americans had to wait until the Second Barbary War of 1815, when Tripoli fell, before the problem was truly settled. The United States itself paid a heavy price, with squadrons sailing four thousand nautical miles and the cost of supply and garrison duty weighing down, while the domestic argument over distant adventure ran on into the slave trade and Anglo-American conflict of the nineteenth century. The old ship Constitution slipped into silence in the yard after the war, becoming a guardian of naval tradition, until she sailed again in 1812 and carried the experience and the fame gathered in the Barbary war into that far greater conflict.
